verdict.rationale: Heap's docs say it automatically captures clicks, pageviews, form submissions and change events out of the box with no developer work, after a single snippet install. Virtualized data lets tracked events be renamed or grouped retroactively, so no per-event tracking code is needed. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of autocapture coverage and accuracy.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can capture clicks, pageviews, and form interactions automatically without writing tracking code for each event

citations.quote: Heap automatically captures a wealth of client-side interactions out-of-the-box, including clicks, pageviews, form submissions, and change events, with no developer work needed.
To get started with Heap, paste the following code snippet before your website’s closing `</head>` tag.
Heap virtualizes your data, so the events you choose to track can be renamed, re-organized, or even grouped with other events after the fact, retroactively.
